batch_tokens.title: Batch token budget
batch_tokens.summary: Sets the approximate token budget for processing one batch.
batch_tokens.description: Controls how much candidate material is grouped for a model-based processing step.

max_model_calls.title: Maximum model calls
max_model_calls.summary: Caps model calls permitted for one tool operation.
max_model_calls.description: Limits computational cost and processing time. Work may stop early before every candidate is examined.

quick_passages.title: Quick-pass passages
quick_passages.summary: Sets how many passages to consider in a quick pass.
quick_passages.description: Bounds the initial passage selection performed before deeper processing when requested.

max_listed.title: Maximum listed results
max_listed.summary: Caps the number of matches or items returned in a list.
max_listed.description: A lower cap produces shorter reports even when additional candidates exist in the source.

confirmation.title: Confirmation policy
confirmation.summary: Controls when user confirmation is required before a tool runs.
confirmation.description: Depending on the selected policy, the tool may ask before processing large or otherwise costly workloads.

large_batches.title: Large workload threshold
large_batches.summary: Sets the batch threshold used by the confirmation policy.
large_batches.description: Used to decide whether a planned multi-batch operation is large enough to request confirmation.
